# Specification Quality Checklist: Reference Implementation Evaluation

**Purpose**: Validate specification completeness and quality before proceeding to planning
**Created**: 2026-09-19
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Scope and Authority

- [x] CHK001 The specification keeps Reference Implementation evaluation advisory and assigns architectural decision ownership exclusively to ADR.
- [x] CHK002 The Version 1 included and excluded scope boundaries are explicit and non-contradictory.
- [x] CHK003 The specification distinguishes Reference Implementation evidence from Recommendation scoring, confidence, rationale, and approval.

## Matching and Counting

- [x] CHK004 Matching rules are explicit, deterministic, and limited to explicit Reference Architecture references.
- [x] CHK005 Unique counting behavior is defined for duplicate references and multiple matching paths.
- [x] CHK006 Missing, unreadable, malformed, and zero-match catalog behavior is specified and testable.
- [x] CHK007 Multiple matched Reference Architectures have a defined count-selection rule.

## Tie-Breaking and Determinism

- [x] CHK008 Tie-break criteria are ordered as Reference Architecture Match, Reference Implementation Count, then lowest `OPT` identifier.
- [x] CHK009 The specification requires evaluation to stop once a criterion selects a single option.
- [x] CHK010 Deterministic inputs and prohibited sources of nondeterminism are explicitly identified.

## Validation Readiness

- [x] CHK011 Acceptance scenarios cover successful matching, duplicate counting, unavailable catalogs, malformed artifacts, and tie resolution.
- [x] CHK012 Success criteria are measurable and map to the functional requirements.
- [x] CHK013 Verification expectations cover score and confidence invariance, advisory boundaries, and repeated execution.
- [x] CHK014 Assumptions and dependencies identify the existing Discovery, Reference Architecture, catalog, and ADR contracts.

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
